name: Unable to Access Account
description: Customers report being unable to get into their accounts.

name: Password Login Failure
description: Customers report that the app will not accept their password.

name: General Billing Complaints
description: Customers express general dissatisfaction related to billing and restrictions.

name: Basic Features Behind Premium
description: Customers say choosing songs, skipping, or playing specific song sections requires Premium.

name: Missing Music in Catalog
description: Customers report that songs or genres they want are unavailable.

name: Missing Song Lyrics
description: Customers report that lyrics are missing for some songs.

name: Offline and Download Problems
description: Customers report offline playback problems or downloads getting stuck.

name: General Dissatisfaction
description: Customers express broad dissatisfaction or objections not tied to a specific feature.

name: Dissatisfaction With Updates
description: Customers say updates have made the app disappointing or worse.

name: App Crashes on Launch
description: Customers report that the app crashes or cannot be opened.

name: Playback and Connectivity Problems
description: Customers report playback stopping or failing, loading issues, or connectivity problems.

name: Support Dissatisfaction
description: Customers express dissatisfaction with the app's support.

name: Excessive or Loud Ads
description: Customers complain that ads are too frequent or too loud.

name: Limited Playback Controls
description: Customers report difficulty controlling song selection, skipping, repeating, or playback order.

name: General Usability Complaints
description: Customers describe the app as difficult to use or complain about intrusive ads and autoplay.

name: Recommendations and Home Screen
description: Customers dislike recommendations, randomized playlist behavior, or the updated home screen.

name: Removed Features After Update
description: Customers say an update removed basic music-player features.
